Convert the doubled parameter vector (length 2dd) into a d x d matrix W

Source: R/lingam_lim.r
lim_adj.Rd

Mirrors Python's w[:d*d].reshape([d, d]) (row-major reshape), so w and the reverse operation lim_flatten_rowmajor() must stay consistent.

Usage

lim_adj(w, d)
